summary: RAG composite best-of-N topology + LoRA v2a_e1
hypothesis: Crossing the ragCompositeBestOfN in-context topology (exp026) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should combine the coverage benefits of RAG-driven best-of-N selection with the quality gains of the fine-tuned weights, beating either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing the ragCompositeBestOfN inference topology from exp026 with the best available LoRA adapter (v2a_e1): retrieval of exemplars feeds a best-of-N ensemble of adapter calls, with greedy decoding at eval time.
result: Scored 0.323 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp026 in-context baseline (0.297) but far below the champion exp056 (0.440). The topology–adapter cross did not transfer the champion's gains; discarded.
